description: Comptages routiers - Anglet is a dataset listed in Anglet Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville d'Anglet. Jeu de données des comptages routiers mis en place par la Ville d'Anglet. Coverage: Anglet. The portal files it under Mobilité, Espace Public. Its keywords are comptage, routier, trafic, véhicule léger, véhicule poids lourd. The portal shows 1,525 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-01-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-anglet-opendatapaysbasque-portal.
